about_the_game:
Reopen and restore a Japanese rural Train Station. Repair, upgrade, and bring it back to life. Play solo or with friends in co-op as you manage services, welcome passengers, and uncover a cozy mystery hidden in the station’s story.

Gameplay

>Start with a closed, abandoned station

>Repair facilities such as ticket machines, floors, and restrooms...

>Upgrade services day by day to unlock new features

>Welcome passengers and keep the station running smoothly

>Progress through weekly goals to advance the story and mystery

Online Multiplayer

>Play together with up to 6 players in co-op

>Host or join lobbies, private or public

>Work together to divide tasks and speed up repairs, help each other through text chat

>Share the mystery and progress as a team

Single Player

>Play the full experience at your own pace

>Relaxing but engaging station management

>Uncover the mystery step by step while running the station solo

Equipments

Repair Tools

>Fix broken facilities and restore functionality

Station Upgrades

>Purchase and improve services for passengers

Notes & Clues

>Discover small hints and details that reveal parts of the station’s story and mystery

Gameplay Features

>Restore and manage a Japanese rural train station

>Play solo or in co-op with friends

>Repair, upgrade, and unlock passenger services

>Daily progression system with clear goals

>Mystery and story woven into cozy management gameplay

Short Story

An abandoned countryside station once full of life now stands silent. Your task: reopen its doors, repair its facilities, and bring passengers back. As you rebuild, you’ll also uncover a mystery connected to the station’s story.

Atmosphere

Set in rural Japan, the station and its surroundings are brought to life with a cozy, hand-crafted aesthetic. The mix of detailed visuals, warm lighting, and thoughtful design creates a gentle but immersive atmosphere. Countryside charm and visuals, Train Station Simulator: Together in Japan blends comfort with discovery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1650
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Unreal Engine 5 Requires Latest update of GPU Driver & Windows 10/11
